title: Image models get a metadata endpoint
summary:
Image model details and wildcard referrers joined the API, while Hacktoberfest gained app starters and the community showcase got a tidy-up.

The image API gained `/about`, which returns each model’s name, tier, enhance flag, and maximum side length as JSON. `/models` still returns names only.

Registered wildcard domains can now authenticate requests from their subdomains without a separate registration for each one. Exact matches take priority, and a wildcard does not cover its parent domain. A separate change added configurable concurrency caps for selected nanobanana and seedream users; other users keep their tier-based caps.

A new Hacktoberfest 2025 folder sets out how to submit frontend apps, with an HTML image-generation starter, a React/Vite placeholder starter, and two examples: CatGPT and the Sirius Cybernetics Elevator Challenge. Contributors can optionally propose an idea for feedback before building.

highlights.title: Image model details via API
highlights.text: Call the image API’s `/about` endpoint to get model names, tiers, enhance flags, and maximum side lengths as JSON. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Wildcard referrer domains
highlights.text: A registered domain such as `*.example.com` can authenticate requests from its subdomains, including nested ones. The parent domain still needs its own match. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Hacktoberfest app starters
highlights.text: Build a frontend Pollinations app using the new HTML starter, or browse CatGPT and the elevator game for ideas. You can propose an idea for feedback before submitting an app. [Read the contributor guide](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
